annotations.title: Default risk: the chance of a bankruptcy filing (Canli model)

description: A Canli model: the chance a company reports a bankruptcy (an 8-K under Item 1.03) within a year of its latest annual report, from that 10-K's own figures, with how it ranks among the year's reports and Ohlson's O and Altman's Z'' beside it. Tested walk-forward on every US GAAP 10-K from 2014 to 2025, the test's results (including where Ohlson's O did better) returned with it. as_of reads the company as it stood on a past day.

as_of.description: Read the latest annual report filed before this day: the model as it would have read the company then.

name: default_risk

outputSchema.description: The chance from the latest 10-K, its rank among the reference year's reports, the cross-checks and the model's validation.

title: Default risk: the chance of a bankruptcy filing (Canli model)
